subject.title: fix(browser): keep CDP discovery on the configured host

question: Should this PR's fail-closed exact-host CDP discovery policy be the approved browser SSRF boundary even if some remote CDP providers previously returned debugger WebSocket URLs on a different host?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but it deliberately tightens a security-sensitive browser control path with possible remote-provider compatibility impact, which automation should not accept as product/security policy on its own.

options.title: Approve Exact-Host Hardening
options.body: Accept the fail-closed host-pivot behavior and land after exact-head required checks complete.

options.title: Require Provider Compatibility Proof
options.body: Ask for additional proof against any remote CDP providers maintainers care about before accepting the stricter boundary.

options.title: Pause For Broader SSRF Direction
options.body: Defer this PR if maintainers want the broader private-network/SSRF confirmation design to define CDP discovery semantics first.

recommendation.title: Approve Exact-Host Hardening
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed host-pivot behavior and land after exact-head required checks complete.
